description: This source file is a Lua script for a graphical application that demonstrates image cropping. It initializes images, creates cropped versions, and animates them within a window, also drawing some UI text.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the application window, loads an image, creates cropped images, and outputs their sizes.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Handles rendering the images and UI text on the canvas and updates the position for animation.
